mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, object_type AS objectType, old_id AS oldId, old_name AS oldName, new_id AS newId, new_name AS newName, old_biz_line AS oldBizLine, new_biz_line AS newBizLine, portal_id AS portalId, is_reused AS isReused, created_by AS createdBy, DATE_FORMAT(created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdTime FROM ssm_migrate_bizsplit_mapping WHERE object_type = 'query_tpl_view' AND old_id = #{oldId} ORDER BY id ASC
